title: Hekkawick
description: A Witchy and Magical Minecraft Modpack and Server
body:
Hekkawick is a modpack hoping to provide a witchy, magical adventure to its players. Enjoy the simple life of the arcane, or battle ferocious beasts of the world, the choice is yours! Explore, cast and conquer!

Still not sure about this pack? Give it a load and see it for yourself, and feel free to give us any suggestions and/or criticism!

Over 30K downloads on Curseforge! 
If you'd like, come join us at hekkawick.modrinth.gg and meet fellow Hekkawick adventurers!
